name: long-running
description: Context discipline for multi-lane orchestration — ground truth arrives only as a lane's verdict, anything with a body is a lane, every wait folds into the lane that acts, no lane parks and no lane is re-briefed, state lives in cc-notes and the task list; ships the landing desk's ledger CLI over cc-notes, one row per PR our lanes shipped, that queues lane reports, grades and routes heads, guards the merge label, holds with a reason and an expiry, settles landings from the base branch, and summarises for the root.
